title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 11, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran, said in answer to our question:
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 11, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran, said in answer to our question:"

""
"=============="

"SOT1, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:24): "What is important is that the world knows that Iran's nuclear program has been completely peaceful and transparent, under the constant supervision of the IAEA. Numerous IAEA reports have shown that Iran has always moved along the right path, maintaining a transparent yet highly advanced program.""

"SOT2, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi)-(00:25 - 01:09): "What I can say is that the nuclear industry has its roots in Iran, and it is not an industry that can be destroyed by strikes. Unfortunately, the enemy still has not understood this; they still lack such an understanding. However, we are certain that, in any case, this is an industry that contributes to various fields, such as health, medicine, agriculture, industry, and other sectors, all of which benefit the country. The Islamic Republic of Iran will certainly continue this path of progress with intensity and strength.""

"SOT3, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi)-(01:10 - 01:44): "There has always been a threat, which we have heard about many times. At the same time, what is certain is that we have always had, and will always have, the necessary foresight. We hope our enemies come to their senses and realize that the Islamic Republic of Iran will not, in fact, yield to force. They cannot achieve through force what they cannot obtain through negotiation.""

"SOT4, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi)-(01:45 - 02:13): "What is important is the rights and interests of the country, and we certainly pursue these through both paths, just as the country's officials have pointed out: the path of negotiation and the path of resistance. Neither contradicts the other. At the negotiating table, too, what the Islamic Republic of Iran wants is an emphasis on its own rights, and no one is permitted to waive these rights.""

"SOT5, Behrouz Kamalvandi, Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi)-(02:14 - 02:33): "The Islamic Republic of Iran will pursue the country's interests with authority and resolve. If these interests can be secured through diplomacy, so much the better; if not, we will certainly secure them with strength and might on the battlefield.
